question.problem: If $z + 9 = 12,$ then what is the value of $z?$
question.worked_solution:
If we substitute ${\color{blue}{z}}={\color{blue}{3}}$ into the given equation, we get a true statement:

$$
\begin{aligned}z+9 & =12 \\ 3+9 & =12 \\ 12 & =12\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $z=3.$
